name: The Fool
upright: You are stepping into a new chapter with curiosity and courage.
reversedMeaning: A leap forward is being blocked by fear or impulsiveness.

scenario.setting: A cliffside trail forks above a bright valley. A traveler with a worn pack waits beside the first step.
scenario.dialogue: “No map, no guarantees. Would you take the first step with me?”

name: The Magician
upright: Your talents and choices can shape the outcome you want.
reversedMeaning: Your power is scattered or being misused right now.

scenario.setting: In a candlelit workshop, a young apprentice faces a table of tools and a device that will not turn on.
scenario.dialogue: “I have everything I need, I think. Can you help me find the missing piece?”

name: The High Priestess
upright: Trust the quiet wisdom beneath the surface.
reversedMeaning: You may be ignoring your instincts or overthinking the answer.

scenario.setting: A moonlit archive is silent except for a sealed letter on the keeper's desk.
scenario.dialogue: “The answer is here, but the letter was not meant for me. What do you sense?”

name: The Empress
upright: Create space for creativity, comfort, and fertile ideas.
reversedMeaning: You may be neglecting care, nourishment, or self-worth.

scenario.setting: Warm rain taps the greenhouse roof while a gardener kneels beside a row of wilting seedlings.
scenario.dialogue: “They need more than water. What would help this little patch thrive?”

name: The Emperor
upright: Clear rules and a steady plan will help you move forward.
reversedMeaning: Control or rigidity may be creating unnecessary friction.

scenario.setting: At the city gate, a storm-damaged wall leaves one narrow passage for a line of waiting families.
scenario.dialogue: “People need order, but these rules are slowing everyone down. What is fair?”

name: The Hierophant
upright: Learning from established wisdom can steady your path.
reversedMeaning: You may be resisting advice or holding onto outdated systems.

scenario.setting: In an old hillside shrine, an acolyte prepares a ceremony whose meaning has been forgotten by the village.
scenario.dialogue: “We have always done it this way. Should we keep the custom or ask why it began?”

name: The Lovers
upright: A meaningful decision is asking for honesty and clarity.
reversedMeaning: Misalignment or conflict is clouding a key relationship.

scenario.setting: Two siblings stand on either side of their late parent's little bookshop, each holding a different key.
scenario.dialogue: “We both love this place, but want different futures for it. Will you hear us out?”

name: The Chariot
upright: Focus and determination are carrying you toward success.
reversedMeaning: Stalled energy or lack of direction is slowing the journey.

scenario.setting: At a rain-slick crossroads, a courier's overloaded cart points toward two urgent deliveries.
scenario.dialogue: “I can only get one there in time. Which way should I steer?”

name: Strength
upright: Calm confidence will win more than force alone.
reversedMeaning: You may be trying to push through without rest or compassion.

scenario.setting: A frightened horse trembles in a stable as thunder rolls outside. Its caretaker keeps a careful distance.
scenario.dialogue: “It will not come close. Can you help me make it feel safe?”

name: The Hermit
upright: Take time away from noise to hear your deeper truth.
reversedMeaning: Isolation is preventing you from seeing the bigger picture.

scenario.setting: High in the mountains, a lighthouse keeper tends a beacon that has gone dark on a foggy night.
scenario.dialogue: “I have worked alone for years. Tonight, I could use another pair of hands.”

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright: A turning point is coming and will move things unexpectedly.
reversedMeaning: You may be resisting a change that is already underway.

scenario.setting: At the market, a broken prize wheel spins in the wind while vendors wait to hear whether the fair can continue.
scenario.dialogue: “The old plan has fallen apart. Do we repair it or try something new?”

name: Justice
upright: Clear decisions and honest review will bring fairness.
reversedMeaning: A hidden truth or unfair bias needs to be confronted.

scenario.setting: Two witnesses disagree in a quiet town hall, and a judge pauses before delivering a verdict.
scenario.dialogue: “Both stories sound certain. What should I ask before I decide?”

name: The Hanged Man
upright: Letting go of urgency can reveal the answer you need.
reversedMeaning: Stubbornness is keeping you stuck in a difficult pause.

scenario.setting: A flooded orchard has trapped a farmer in the upper branches of an old tree.
scenario.dialogue: “I can wait for the water to drop, or risk climbing down. What do you see?”

name: Death
upright: A chapter is closing so a stronger one can begin.
reversedMeaning: An ending is being delayed or avoided instead of honored.

scenario.setting: The last curtain falls in a small theater scheduled to close, and the stagehand gathers the final props.
scenario.dialogue: “The show is over. Which part should we carry with us into whatever comes next?”

name: Temperance
upright: Steady moderation will help everything settle into place.
reversedMeaning: Extremes or inconsistency are making the path harder.

scenario.setting: In an apothecary, two jars of ingredients sit open beside a healer trying to mix a soothing remedy.
scenario.dialogue: “Too much of either will make it worse. How should I find the right measure?”

name: The Devil
upright: A habit or fear may be keeping you from freedom.
reversedMeaning: You are beginning to break unhealthy patterns and reclaim power.

scenario.setting: Deep in a mine, a foreman finds a ledger showing that workers are bound by a debt they cannot repay.
scenario.dialogue: “This bargain keeps everyone trapped. What would it take to break the pattern?”

name: The Tower
upright: A sudden shake-up can clear away what no longer fits.
reversedMeaning: You may be bracing for change without yet accepting it.

scenario.setting: After a lightning strike cracks the old bell tower, a mason points to a safer path through the square.
scenario.dialogue: “The old tower will not stand. How do we get everyone clear and begin again?”

name: The Star
upright: A hopeful path is opening, even if the next step is unclear.
reversedMeaning: You may be doubting your own ability to recover or dream boldly.

scenario.setting: On the roof of an observatory, a young astronomer searches the clearing sky for one familiar star.
scenario.dialogue: “The clouds are finally lifting. Which direction should we look first?”

name: The Moon
upright: Not everything is clear yet; let the fog reveal what it can.
reversedMeaning: Confusion is lifting and truth is becoming easier to see.

scenario.setting: Fog closes around a marsh ferry as its keeper hears an uncertain bell from somewhere across the water.
scenario.dialogue: “I cannot see the shore. Do we wait for the fog to pass, or trust the sound?”

name: The Sun
upright: Warmth, confidence, and visibility are in your favor.
reversedMeaning: You may be dimming your own light or avoiding celebration.

scenario.setting: A village festival fills the sunlit square while a baker brings out the first loaf from a new oven.
scenario.dialogue: “The whole town helped build this. Who should we invite to share the first slice?”

name: Judgement
upright: A call to act with integrity is worth answering now.
reversedMeaning: You may be resisting an honest evaluation or a necessary reset.

scenario.setting: A messenger returns to the town square with news that may change a decision everyone thought was final.
scenario.dialogue: “There is still time to answer the call. Are we ready to hear what has changed?”

name: The World
upright: You are arriving at a meaningful completion and new wholeness.
reversedMeaning: A finishing cycle may be delayed until you fully integrate the lesson.

scenario.setting: At the harbor's edge, a mapmaker lays out a chart joining routes from every place you have visited.
scenario.dialogue: “The journey brought us all here. Where should the next map begin?”
